title: Dream intervention click handler is a no-op stub — action card appears available but does nothing
description:
When clicking the Dream action card (which shows as available with enough mind essence), nothing happens. The card briefly shows an active/pressed state but no AgendaPicker or InterventionConfirm UI appears. The user is left with no feedback about why clicking had no effect.

Repro steps:
1. Start game, generate world (seed 42), pick Storm Marshal, ascend
2. Advance to ~Tick 22+ so mind essence exceeds 1.0
3. Click Actions tab → Dream card shows as available (no 'Not enough' message, cursor=pointer)
4. Click Dream card → nothing happens, card briefly highlights then returns to normal

Root cause: In useAgentInteraction.ts lines 131-133, the handleWheelSlotClick function had an explicit early return for dream interventions:
```
if (slot.interventionType === 'dream') {
  return;
}
```
This bypassed the entire agenda generation + picker flow that works correctly for other interventions.
evidence: src/components/Game/hooks/useAgentInteraction.ts lines 131-133: bare `return` for dream type. Confirmed by testing: Persuade flow (Action Card → AgendaPicker → InterventionConfirm → execution) works end-to-end at Tick 52.
resolution: Dream stub removed. Re-tested 2026-03-10: Dream, Persuade, and Inspire all work end-to-end at Tick 50 on agent Brynn (seed 42, Storm Marshal). Full flow: ActionCard click → AgendaPicker (4 agendas each) → InterventionConfirm (cost/detection shown) → execution with Chronicle entry and essence deduction. Dream cost 1 mind, Persuade cost 2 spirit, Inspire cost 2 life. All undetected. Total essence 65→60.

title: No user feedback when clicking a disabled/unavailable action card
description:
When clicking action cards that are unavailable (e.g., 'Not enough spirit essence', 'Requires tier 2'), the card does nothing — no tooltip, no shake animation, no visual feedback. The card renders as a <button> element but with no cursor change or disabled styling that clearly communicates non-interactivity.

Repro steps:
1. At early ticks with low essence, open Actions tab
2. Click any card showing 'Not enough X essence' or 'Requires tier N'
3. Observe: nothing happens, no feedback

The blocking reason text is shown but it's small and easy to miss. Users may repeatedly click thinking it should work.
evidence: ActionCard.tsx handleClick guard: `if (isAvailable && !playing)` silently returns. Cards without cursor=pointer in snapshot have no disabled ARIA attribute. Re-test 2026-03-10 confirms: tier-locked cards (Deceive, Intimidate, Coincidence, Omen, Afflict/Bless) correctly render with [disabled] attribute but have no visual feedback on click.
suggestedFix: Add aria-disabled='true' and a visual disabled state (opacity, cursor:not-allowed) to unavailable cards. Consider a subtle shake animation or tooltip on click of disabled cards.
